field_notes.creator: Instagram handle of the reel's creator, without the @ (e.g. "melissaortarealtor").
field_notes.notes: Short note on what the reel shows and why it was harvested — which effect or move it demonstrates.
field_notes.style_tags: List of style slugs from data/styles.json that this reel demonstrates (e.g. ["kelsie-flythrough", "melissa-vision-pitch"]).

harvest_plan: Harvest 1,000+ real-estate-style reels with strong graphics. Primary pool: the mt1jay For You feed, collected in batches by scrolling the logged-in browser session (Instagram API does not expose the For You page or watch history). Fallback pool: mt1jay + akhisharafath saved posts and followed creators. Each harvested reel is studied (what the edit does, which style tags apply) and appended here.
harvest_status: Harvest 1 (2026-11-17): mt1jay saved posts (103 scanned) + DMs on both accounts back to Nov 1, 2026 (84 threads, 66 URLs). 35 reels kept, 55 dropped. FYP harvest (1,000 target) still pending on the mt1jay browser login.
